div.head: I Atr 1.9a
div.ab: ⁊ gif heo forð ne cume, fo se cyning to þam were, ⁊ beo se þeof utlah wið eall folc.
And gyf héo forð ne cume, fo se cyng to ðam were, ⁊ beo se ðeof utlah wið eal folc.
Si non procedat, habeat rex weram, et sit ipse fur utlagatus apud omnem populum.
⁊ gyf héo forð ne cume, fo se cyng to ðam were ⁊ beo se ðeof utlah wið eal folc.
And if he fails, the king shall take the wergeld, and the thief shall be treated as an outlaw by all the nation.
Und wenn sie nicht zu Stande kommt, erhalte der König dies Wergeld. Und jener Dieb sei friedlos beim ganzen Volke.
And if it does not succeed, let the king take that wergild. And let the thief be an outlaw with respect to the whole people.
